A '''battle''' took place at the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] astronomical object [[Fanha/Legends|Fanha]] in [[17 BBY/Legends|17 BBY]] as part of the [[Reconquest of the Rim]] campaign's [[Western Reaches Operation]]. Following an [[Ambush at Bryndar|ambush]] by the [[Iska pirates/Legends|Iska pirates]] at the Outer Rim<ref name="TEGtW" /> [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="Bryndar">{{CSWECite|I|95|Bryndar}}</ref> [[Bryndar]], [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] [[Imperial Military/Legends|military forces]] under [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Terrinald Screed/Legends|Terrinald Screed]] and the [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Shea Hublin]] decimated the Iska [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] at Fanha, forcing the pirate [[Lord/Legends|lord]] [[Guun Cutlax]] to flee into the [[Atravis sector/Legends|Atravis sector]]. There, Cutlax rendezvoused with [[Separatist holdouts/Legends|holdouts]] of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Indepent Systems]] that had been defeated during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] [[19 BBY/Legends|two years]] earlier. The [[Privateer/Legends|privateers]] led by Cutlax were later [[Battle of Tosste/Legends|defeated]] by the Empire at the Outer Rim<ref name="TEGtW" /> planet<ref name="TWoDM">''[[The Wrath of Darth Maul]]''</ref> [[Tosste/Legends|Tosste]] in 17 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]].<ref name="TEGtW" />

==Behind the scenes==
The battle of Fanha was introduced in the [[2012]] reference book ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'', written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Paul R. Urquhart]].<ref name="TEGtW" />
